en: The black-and-white image shows a cobblestone town square with a decorative fountain in the center, surrounded by ornate ironwork. Around the square are multi-story buildings with steep gabled roofs and dormer windows, typical of German or Central European architecture. Visible signs on the buildings include 'Otto Walther.', 'Otto Egerl.', 'Hermann Streubel in.', and 'MOHREN APOTHEKE.' There are a few people walking, a horse-drawn carriage, and an early automobile, suggesting an early 20th-century setting.
